newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded on Monday a man for stabbing another man to death during a brawl, Saudi state-run television reported.
It quoted an interior ministry statement as saying Mohammad bin Abdullah Ubayed al-Miqati was executed in the summer resort town of Taif in western Saudi Arabia.
The beheading brought to 47 the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
